test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct,**

You __can't bought anything__ with one cent anymore.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**can't buy anything**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb '**bought**' is in the past tense, but the sentence is talking about present ability. It should be changed to the present tense '**buy**'.
 
• The negative form of 'can' is 'can't', not 'cannot'.
 
• '**Anything**' is the correct word to use in this sentence to refer to any item or object.
 
• The word 'anymore' indicates a change or contrast with the past, so it is used correctly in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Corrected sentence**: *You can't buy anything with one cent anymore*.
